name: phase22_pronunciation_audit
purpose: Controlled Vietnamese pronunciation corpus for the 'người' syllable-loss audit and future listening rounds. Words chosen for shared rhyme/-ươi patterns and dense diacritics. Diagnostics only; never submitted to history or experiments automatically.

manual_listening.preset_control: Select any entry under 'Giọng mặc định' in the main voice selector (name comes from the installed VieNeu model, e.g. 'Trúc Ly'). The prompt template said 'Adam'; use whatever preset your build lists.
sentences: Người Việt Nam luôn yêu tiếng Việt.
